Messages.Author: mr_b...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
In article <88b0kb$u50$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,

mads...@my-deja.com wrote:
> Who exactly determines who can call a bloodhunt/wyldhunt and do sabbat
> and camarilla vampires differ in votes(sabbat can only vote in
> wyldhunts and camarilla can only vote in bloodg=hunts)?
>

What I know, any Methuselah (not vampire)can call Bloodhunt/wildhunt.
Wild hunt is only another term for Blood hunt, so it is the same
"action". This also meen that during Bloodhunt can each vampire
(camarilla, sabbat, other) vote, as well as during Wildhunt.

> For example if Joaqina Amaya diablerizes Gratiano, who can call a hunt
> and what type is it?What if Democritus is diablerized by Nigel the
> Shunned, what happens then?
>

Any Methuselah can call a Hunt. I think if you play with sabbat vampires
only then you call Wild Hunt. If you play with camarilla vampires ...you
call Blood Hunt.
But I'm not sure what is this Hunt when you play with both camarilla and
sabbat vampires :).

Messages.Author: msa...@cc.jyu.fi
Messages.Body:
Quoth the mads...@my-deja.com:

> For example if Joaqina Amaya diablerizes Gratiano, who can call a hunt
> and what type is it?What if Democritus is diablerized by Nigel the
> Shunned, what happens then?

Consider all the different bloodhunts the same. All these actions result
in bloodhunt (whatever it is called, doesn't matter) if someone just calls
it. In theory, I guess, it's bloodhunt if it's called on Camarilla vampire
and wyldhunt if on Sabbat on vampire, but that has no effect on game.
